title: Diamond with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Diamond body -->
  <polygon points='50,18 82,40 50,88 18,40' fill='#5fd4f7'/>
  <!-- Top facet highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,18 82,40 50,40' fill='#9fe8ff'/>
  <polygon points='50,18 18,40 50,40' fill='#c4f2ff'/>
  <!-- Bottom facets -->
  <polygon points='18,40 50,40 50,88' fill='#3bb8de'/>
  <polygon points='82,40 50,40 50,88' fill='#2a9cc4'/>
  <!-- Table line highlight -->
  <polygon points='22,38 50,38 50,42 22,42' fill='#e8f9ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <polygon points='78,38 50,38 50,42 78,42' fill='#d0f4ff' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- Sparkle top left -->
  <polygon points='32,22 34,28 40,30 34,32 32,38 30,32 24,30 30,28' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='52' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='50' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M38,64 Q50,76 62,64' stroke='#1a1a3a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='62' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='62' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Sparkle bottom right -->
  <polygon points='72,72 73.5,76 77,77.5 73.5,79 72,83 70.5,79 67,77.5 70.5,76' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
